copy.tagline: 自动切换备用方案执行代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果沙箱环境不稳定需要可靠执行代码
copy.tagline_en: Automatically fallback to execute code reliably
copy.fit_line_en: For you if sandbox environment is unreliable and you need robust code execution

howto.what: 当代码沙箱连续失败两次以上时，Claude会自动改用先写文件再通过shell执行的方式运行代码，并捕获输出结果。
howto.when: 当execute_code_sandbox连续失败两次或更多，或遇到超时、环境错误等无法通过代码修复的问题时触发。

say.text: 试试用写文件再执行的方式运行这段Python代码。
say.note: Claude会生成脚本文件并通过shell执行。

say.text: 如果沙箱失败，改用shell执行这个脚本。
say.note: 触发回退流程，提高执行成功率。

say.text: 用文件方式运行，避免沙箱序列化问题。

howto.what_en: When the code sandbox fails twice or more consecutively, Claude automatically switches to writing the script to a file and executing it via shell, capturing stdout/stderr output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when execute_code_sandbox fails 2+ times consecutively, or when encountering timeout/environment errors that are not fixable by code changes.

say_en.text: Try running this Python code by writing to file and executing via shell.
say_en.note: Claude will create a script and run it with run_shell.

say_en.text: If sandbox fails, fallback to shell execution for this script.
say_en.note: Triggers fallback workflow for reliable execution.

say_en.text: Use file-based execution to bypass sandbox serialization issues.
